colophon.en: Jesus Christ did show himself unto the people of Nephi, as the multitude were gathered together in the land Bountiful, and did minister unto them; and on this wise did he show himself unto them. Comprising chapters 11 through 26.
colophon.sm: Na faaali mai e Iesu Keriso o ia lava i le nuu o Nifae, ao faapotopoto faatasi le motu o tagata i le laueleele o Nuumau, ma sa ia auauna atu ia te i latou; ma sa faapenei ona ia faaali mai o ia lava ia te i latou. E aofia ai mataupu 11 e oo atu i le 26.

heading.en: The Father testifies of His Beloved Son—Christ appears and proclaims His Atonement—The people feel the wound marks in His hands and feet and side—They cry Hosanna—He sets forth the mode and manner of baptism—The spirit of contention is of the devil—Christ's doctrine is that men should believe and be baptized and receive the Holy Ghost. About A.D. 34.
heading.sm: Ua molimau le Tamā i Lona Alo Pele—Ua afio mai Keriso ma tautino mai Lana Togiola—Ua pai atu tagata i manua i Ona lima, ma vae, ma lona itu—Ua latou alalaga, Osana—Ua ia faatuina le ala ma le faiga o le papatisoga—O le agaga o le finau e mai le tiapolo—O le mataupu a Keriso o le tatau lea i tagata ona salamo ma papatiso ma talia le Agaga Paia. E tusa o le 34 T.A.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that there were a great multitude gathered together, of the people of Nephi, round about the temple which was in the land Bountiful; and they were marveling and wondering one with another, and were showing one to another the great and marvelous change which had taken place.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina sa i ai se motu o tagata e toatele, o le nuu o Nifae, sa faapotopoto faatasi faataamilo i le malumalu lea sa i le laueleele o Nuumau; ma sa latou maofa ma taufaiofo o le tasi i le isi, ma faaali atu e le tasi i le isi suiga tetele ma ofoofogia ia ua oo mai.

w.en: there was a great multitude of people,

verses.en: And they were also conversing about this Jesus Christ, of whom the sign had been given concerning his death.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou fetautalatalaai foi e uiga i lenei Iesu Keriso, o le na faatatau i ai le faailoga na tuuina mai e uiga i lona maliu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that while they were thus conversing one with another, they heard a voice as if it came out of heaven; and they cast their eyes round about, for they understood not the voice which they heard; and it was not a harsh voice, neither was it a loud voice; nevertheless, and notwithstanding it being a small voice it did pierce them that did hear to the center, insomuch that there was no part of their frame that it did not cause to quake; yea, it did pierce them to the very soul, and did cause their hearts to burn.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ao faapea ona latou fetautalatalaai o le tasi i le isi, sa latou faalogoina se leo e peiseai ua sau mai le lagi; ma sa latou fevaavaaiai solo, ona sa latou le malamalama i le leo lea sa latou faalogoina; ma sa le o se leo saua, pe o se leo tele, ae ui i lea, ma e ui lava o se leo itiiti ae sa tuia ai le totonugalemu o i latou o e na faalogo i ai, sa oo ina leai se vaega o o latou tino sa lei gatete ai; ioe, sa ati lava i o latou agaga, na mafua ai ona mu o latou loto.

w.en: And it came to pass that
and it was not a harsh voice,
and though it was a small voice

verses.en: And it came to pass that again they heard the voice, and they understood it not.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou toe faalogoina le leo, ma sa latou le malamalama i ai.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And again the third time they did hear the voice, and did open their ears to hear it; and their eyes were towards the sound thereof; and they did look steadfastly towards heaven, from whence the sound came.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou toe faalogoina le leo i le taimi lona tolu, ma sa latou tatala atu o latou taliga e faalogo i ai; ma na faasaga atu o latou mata i le mea na sau ai lea leo; ma sa latou tetepa taulai faasaga atu i le lagi, i le mea na sau ai le leo.

w.en: And they heard the voice again
towards where that voice came from;
to where the voice came from.

verses.en: And behold, the third time they did understand the voice which they heard; and it said unto them:
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o le taimi lona tolu na latou malamalama ai i le leo lea na latou faalogoina; ma sa fetalai mai ia te i latou:

verses.en: Behold my Beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased, in whom I have glorified my name—hear ye him.
verses.sm: Faauta i lo’u Atalii Pele, o lē ua ou fiafia lava i ai, o lē ua ou faamamaluina ai lo’u igoa— ia outou faalogo ia te ia.

w.en: in whom I am well pleased,

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they understood they cast their eyes up again towards heaven; and behold, they saw a Man descending out of heaven; and he was clothed in a white robe; and he came down and stood in the midst of them; and the eyes of the whole multitude were turned upon him, and they durst not open their mouths, even one to another, and wist not what it meant, for they thought it was an angel that had appeared unto them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua latou malamalama sa latou toe tetepa ae o latou mata faasaga i le lagi; ma faauta, sa latou vaaia se Tagata ua afio ifo mai le lagi; ma sa laei o ia i se ofutalaloa paepae; ma sa afio ifo o ia ma tu i le totonugalemu o i latou; ma sa liliu atu mata o le motu atoa o tagata ia te ia, ma sa latou fefefe e tatala o latou gutu, e oo lava o le tasi i le isi, ma sa latou lē iloa le uiga o lenei mea, ona sa latou manatu o se agelu lea ua faaali mai ia te i latou.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that he stretched forth his hand and spake unto the people, saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ia faaloaloa mai lona aao ma fetalai mai i tagata, ua faapea mai:

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Behold, I am Jesus Christ, whom the prophets testified shall come into the world.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o Iesu Keriso, o lē na molimau i ai perofeta o le a sau i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And behold, I am the light and the life of the world; and I have drunk out of that bitter cup which the Father hath given me, and have glorified the Father in taking upon me the sins of the world, in the which I have suffered the will of the Father in all things from the beginning.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o A’u o le malamalama ma le ola o le lalolagi; ma ua ou inu i lena ipu oona lea na tuuina mai e le Tamā ia te au, ma ua ou faamamaluina le Tamā i lo’u tau aveina i o’u luga o agasala a le lalolagi, o se mea na ou tuuina atu ai i le finagalo o le Tamā i mea uma mai le amataga.

w.en: and the life of the world;
and I have glorified the Father
to the will of the Father

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words the whole multitude fell to the earth; for they remembered that it had been prophesied among them that Christ should show himself unto them after his ascension into heaven.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fetalai mai e Iesu o ia upu sa pa’u’ū ifo le motu atoa o tagata i le eleele; ona ua latou manatua sa valoia mai ia te i latou o le a faaali mai e Keriso o ia lava ia te i latou pe a mavae lona afio a’e i le lagi.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord spake unto them saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fetalai mai le Alii ia te i latou ua faapea mai:

verses.en: Arise and come forth unto me, that ye may thrust your hands into my side, and also that ye may feel the prints of the nails in my hands and in my feet, that ye may know that I am the God of Israel, and the God of the whole earth, and have been slain for the sins of the world.
verses.sm: Tutula’i ia ma o mai ia te a’u, ina ia outou tuu mai o outou lima i lo’u itu, ma ina ia outou tagotago foi i tulaga o fao o i o’u lima ma o’u vae, ina ia outou iloa ai o A’u o le Atua o Isaraelu, ma le Atua o le lalolagi uma, ma sa fasiotia mo agasala a le lalolagi.

w.en: that ye may put your hands
and that ye may also feel
in my hands and my feet,
I am the God of Israel,
and the God of the whole earth,
for the sins of the world.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the multitude went forth, and thrust their hands into his side, and did feel the prints of the nails in his hands and in his feet; and this they did do, going forth one by one until they had all gone forth, and did see with their eyes and did feel with their hands, and did know of a surety and did bear record, that it was he, of whom it was written by the prophets, that should come.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina o atu le motu o tagata i luma, ma tuu atu o latou lima i lona itu, ma latou tagotago i tulaga o fao i ona lima ma ona vae; ma sa latou faia lenei mea, i le o atu i luma taitoatasi seia oo ina latou o atu uma, ma vaai i o latou mata ma tago atu i ai o latou lima, ma latou iloa mautinoa ai ma molimau ai, o ia lava lea, o lē na tusia e perofeta, o le a afio mai.

w.en: And it came to pass that
in his hands and his feet;
and they knew of a surety

verses.en: And when they had all gone forth and had witnessed for themselves, they did cry out with one accord, saying:
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou o atu uma ma molimau mo i latou lava, sa latou alalaga faatasi, ua fai mai:

w.en: And when they had all gone forth

verses.en: Hosanna! Blessed be the name of the Most High God! And they did fall down at the feet of Jesus, and did worship him.
verses.sm: Osana! Ia faamanuina lava le suafa o le Atua Silisili Ese! Ma sa latou faapa’u’ū ifo i vae o Iesu, ma tapuai atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he spake unto Nephi (for Nephi was among the multitude) and he commanded him that he should come forth.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fetalai mai o ia ia Nifae (ona sa i ai Nifae i totonu o le motu o tagata) ma ia poloai mai ia te ia ia alu atu o ia i luma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And Nephi arose and went forth, and bowed himself before the Lord and did kiss his feet.
verses.sm: Ma sa tulai Nifae ma alu atu i luma, ma ifo atu o ia lava i luma o le Alii ma sogi atu i ona aao.

verses.en: And the Lord commanded him that he should arise. And he arose and stood before him.
verses.sm: Ma sa poloai mai le Alii ia te ia ia tulai. Ma sa tulai o ia ma ua tu i ona luma.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him: I give unto you power that ye shall baptize this people when I am again ascended into heaven.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te ia: Ou te tuu atu ia te oe le mana e te papatiso ai nei tagata pe a ou toe alu a’e i le lagi.

verses.en: And again the Lord called others, and said unto them likewise; and he gave unto them power to baptize. And he said unto them: On this wise shall ye baptize; and there shall be no disputations among you.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe valaauina isi e le Alii, ma faapea foi ona ia fetalai atu ia te i latou; ma sa ia tuu atu ia te i latou le mana e papatiso atu ai. Ma sa ia fetalai atu ia te i latou: O le ala lenei ia outou papatiso atu ai; ma o le a leai ai ni finauga i totonu ia te outou.

w.en: and there shall be no disputes

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, that whoso repenteth of his sins through your words and desireth to be baptized in my name, on this wise shall ye baptize them—Behold, ye shall go down and stand in the water, and in my name shall ye baptize them.
verses.sm: E moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, soo se tasi e salamo i ana agasala e ala i a outou upu, ma manao e papatiso i lo’u igoa, o le ala lenei ia outou papatisoina ai i latou— Faauta, ia outou o ifo ma tutulai i totonu o le vai, ma i lo’u igoa ia outou papatisoina ai i latou.

w.en: in which ye shall baptize them—
ye shall go down and stand

verses.en: And now behold, these are the words which ye shall say, calling them by name, saying:
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o upu nei ia outou faia, ma ta’u i latou i o latou igoa, ma fai atu:

verses.en: Having authority given me of Jesus Christ, I baptize you in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost. Amen.
verses.sm: Ona ua tuuina mai ia te a’u le pule e Iesu Keriso, ou te papatiso ia te oe i le suafa o le Tamā, ma le Alo, ma le Agaga Paia. Amene.

w.en: in the name of the Father,

verses.en: And then shall ye immerse them in the water, and come forth again out of the water.
verses.sm: Ma ona outou faatofu lea o i latou i totonu o le vai, ma toe faatulai a’e mai le vai.

verses.en: And after this manner shall ye baptize in my name; for behold, verily I say unto you, that the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Ghost are one; and I am in the Father, and the Father in me, and the Father and I are one.
verses.sm: Ma o le ala lenei ia outou papatiso atu ai i lo’u igoa; aua faauta, e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le Tamā, ma le Alo, ma le Agaga Paia ua tasi; ma o a’u ua i totonu o le Tamā, ma o le Tamā ua i totonu o a’u, ma o le Tamā ma a’u ua tasi.

w.en: and I am in the Father,
and the Father is in me,

verses.en: And according as I have commanded you thus shall ye baptize. And there shall be no disputations among you, as there have hitherto been; neither shall there be disputations among you concerning the points of my doctrine, as there have hitherto been.
verses.sm: Ma ia faapea lava ona outou papatiso atu e pei ona ou poloaiina ai outou. Ma ia aua nei i ai ni finauga i totonu ia te outou, e pei ona sa i ai e oo mai i le taimi nei; pe i ai foi ni finauga i totonu ia te outou e uiga i matautu o la’u aoaoga faavae, e pei ona sa i ai e oo mai i le taimi nei.

w.en: And let there be no disputes
concerning the points of my doctrine,

verses.en: For verily, verily I say unto you, he that hath the spirit of contention is not of me, but is of the devil, who is the father of contention, and he stirreth up the hearts of men to contend with anger, one with another.
verses.sm: Aua e moni, e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, o lē e i ai le agaga o finauga ua lē mai ia te a’u o ia, ae ua mai le tiapolo ia, o lē o le tamā o finauga, ma ua faaoso e ia loto o tagata ia fefinauai ma le ita, o le tasi i le isi.

w.en: who is the father of contention,

verses.en: Behold, this is not my doctrine, to stir up the hearts of men with anger, one against another; but this is my doctrine, that such things should be done away.
verses.sm: Faauta, e le o la’u aoaoga faavae lea, le faaoso o loto o tagata i le ita, o le tasi e faasaga i le isi; ae o la’u aoaoga faavae lenei, ia aveesea mea faapena.

w.en: the stirring up of the hearts of men
that such things be done away.

verses.en: Behold, verily, verily, I say unto you, I will declare unto you my doctrine.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a ou ta’u atu ia te outou la’u aoaoga faavae.

verses.en: And this is my doctrine, and it is the doctrine which the Father hath given unto me; and I bear record of the Father, and the Father beareth record of me, and the Holy Ghost beareth record of the Father and me; and I bear record that the Father commandeth all men, everywhere, to repent and believe in me.
verses.sm: Ma o la’u aoaoga faavae lenei, ma o le aoaoga faavae lea na tuu mai e le Tamā ia te a’u; ma ou te molimau atu e uiga i le Tamā, ma e molimau mai le Tamā e uiga ia te a’u, ma o le Agaga Paia e molimau e uiga i le Tamā ma a’u; ma ou te molimau atu ua poloaiina e le Tamā tagata uma, i soo se mea o i ai, ia salamo ma talitonu mai ia te a’u.

w.en: and it is the doctrine which
and the Holy Ghost bears record

verses.en: And whoso believeth in me, and is baptized, the same shall be saved; and they are they who shall inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi e talitonu mai ia te a’u, ma papatisoina, o ia lava lea o le a faaolaina; ma o i latou ia o ē o le a mautofi i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: And whoso believeth not in me, and is not baptized, shall be damned.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi e lē talitonu mai ia te au, ma lē papatisoina, o le a faasalaina.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that this is my doctrine, and I bear record of it from the Father; and whoso believeth in me believeth in the  Father also; and unto him will the Father bear record of me, for he will visit him with fire and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o la’u aoaoga faavae lenei, ma ou te molimau atu ua mai le Tamā; ma o soo se tasi e talitonu mai ia te a’u ua talitonu foi i le Tamā; ma o ia o le a molimau i ai le Tamā e uiga ia te a’u, ona o le a asiasi mai o ia ia te ia i le afi ma le Agaga Paia.

w.en: with fire and the Holy Ghost.

verses.en: And thus will the Father bear record of me, and the Holy Ghost will bear record unto him of the Father and me; for the Father, and I, and the Holy Ghost are one.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapea ona molimau mai o le Tamā e uiga ia te a’u, ma o le Agaga Paia o le a molimau mai ia te ia e uiga i le Tamā ma a’u; aua o le Tamā, ma a’u, ma le Agaga Paia ua tasi.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, ye must repent, and become as a little child, and be baptized in my name, or ye can in nowise receive these things.
verses.sm: Ma ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, e ao ina outou salamo, ma avea e pei o se tamaitiiti, ma papatiso i lo’u igoa, a leai e lē mafai lava ona outou maua o nei mea.

w.en: ye can in no wise receive

verses.en: And again I say unto you, ye must repent, and be baptized in my name, and become as a little child, or ye can in nowise inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ma ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, e ao ina outou salamo, ma papatiso i lo’u igoa, ma avea e pei o se tamaitiiti, a leai e le mafai lava ona outou mautofi i le malo o le Atua.

w.en: ye can in no wise inherit

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that this is my doctrine, and whoso buildeth upon this buildeth upon my rock, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against them.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o la’u aoaoga faavae lenei, ma o soo se tasi e atiae i luga o lenei mataupu ua atiae i luga o la’u papa, ma o le a le manumalo faitotoa o seoli e faasaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: And whoso shall declare more or less than this, and establish it for my doctrine, the same cometh of evil, and is not built upon my rock; but he buildeth upon a sandy foundation, and the gates of hell stand open to receive such when the floods come and the winds beat upon them.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi na te tala’i atu e faapei o lenei, ma faatuina e faapea o la’u aoaoga faavae lea, o ia lava lea ua sau mai i le leaga, ma ua le atiae i luga o la’u papa; ae ua atiae i luga o se faavae oneone, ma o le a tutu matalatala mai faitotoa o seoli e talia i latou pe a oo mai lologa ma pesi mai matagi i luga o i latou.

w.en: as if it were my doctrine,

verses.en: Therefore, go forth unto this people, and declare the words which I have spoken, unto the ends of the earth.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou o atu i lenei nuu, ma tala’i atu upu ua ou tautala atu ai, e oo atu i tuluiga o le lalolagi.
